title: Executory
summary: EXEC'UTORY, adjective Performing official duties. 1. In law, to be executed or carried into effect in future; to take effect on a future contingency; as an executory devise or remainder.

inlines.v: EXEC'UTORY, adjective Performing official duties. 1. In law, to be executed or carried into effect in future; to take effect on a future contingency; as an executory devise or remainder.
